steps.prompt: The puck is in the far corner. Their LD slides along the blue line toward the middle. What are they looking for?

options.text: A D-to-D pass from their RD
options.fb: Right. Their LD is getting open for a pass from their RD and a shot. They are the player you watch, with the puck still in view.

options.text: A long pass straight from the corner
options.fb: Possible, but that pass has to cross the slot, where you stand. The quick, safe pass is D-to-D from their RD.

options.text: A chance to join the fight for the puck
options.fb: No. Their LD is moving away from the puck, into open ice. If you watch the puck, they slip behind you and the D-to-D pass finds them alone.

options.text: A rebound in front of our net
options.fb: Our RD and our C have the net. Their LD stays high, where a pass gives them time and a lane to shoot.

steps.prompt: The D-to-D pass is on its way to their LD. You are in the high slot. What do you do?

options.text: Step out toward their LD right now
options.fb: Right. The pass and your skate out both take about half a second. You arrive as they catch it, two meters away, and their shot has to go through you.

options.text: Wait until they catch it, then step out
options.fb: Right idea, half a second late. They catch it with time to look up, and shoot through the lane you are still skating into.

options.text: Stay in the slot and block from there
options.fb: From the slot you are six meters from their LD. They shoot through an open lane, or skate in and shoot from closer.

options.text: Turn back to watch the puck in the corner
options.fb: Your back is to their LD. They catch it with nobody near and shoot, and you hear the shot before you see it.

steps.prompt: The D-to-D pass is on its way. Tap where you should be.

fb.right: Out of the slot, moving into the lane between their LD and our net. You get there as the puck does.
fb.close: Moving the right way, but a stride short of their lane. They get a look at the net before you arrive.
fb.wrong: Still in the middle, or near the puck. They catch it with nobody in the lane and shoot.
